title: Project B — High-Performance Vue Application
summary: Take an intentionally slow Vue application and optimize it using the measurement discipline: record baseline metrics, fix rendering/network/runtime bottlenecks, and prove every win with before/after numbers.
requirements: Baseline recorded BEFORE any change: LCP, INP proxy, bundle size, request count, long tasks
Route-level code splitting with dynamic imports — initial bundle documented before/after
Image optimization: modern formats, explicit dimensions (no CLS), lazy loading below the fold
Vue runtime fixes: computed over methods in templates, stable keys, virtualized long list
No long tasks over 50ms on the main flow (verified in the Performance panel)
Cache headers story: static assets immutable, HTML revalidated (ETag)
A MEASUREMENT REPORT: every optimization paired with its before/after numbers and the profiling method used

milestones.title: Baseline & inventory
milestones.detail: Metrics recorded; bottleneck list ranked by measured impact.

milestones.title: Bundle diet
milestones.detail: Route splitting + tree-shake audit; initial JS reduced with proof.

milestones.title: Runtime smoothing
milestones.detail: Long tasks eliminated; list virtualized; re-renders tamed.

milestones.detail: Before/after report; performance budgets added to CI.
